lines: That thought had too many blank pages.
I have seen bad sources with more sense than that.
Careful. Even ink looks softer than your manners right now.
You walk in like trouble forgot to close the door behind it.
I have seen broken record-keeping with better instincts than you.
Careful. The village has long memories and very little patience today.
You are not as frightening as you think. That may be the problem.
If foolishness made noise, you would drown out the bell.
Do not test me just because I am speaking in complete sentences.
Your confidence is <shake>louder</shake> than your sense.
You are a blank page that somehow still needs correction.
I have read smudges with more purpose.
That thought belongs in the damaged pile.
Your manners are overdue and accruing penalties.
Even a torn page has more context than you provided.
You speak like a rumor that failed proofreading.
I would shelve that opinion under avoidable mistakes.
A dull quill has made sharper points.
Your confidence has no citations and many stains.
That remark was all cover and no text.
You make silence look well educated.
I could bind a book before binding that logic together.
Even the footnotes are distancing themselves from you.
Your argument has dog ears and water damage.
A misplaced book is less lost than you sound.
